max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: Slay the Muddled Prophet of Sseratus and then return to Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand.

tasks.name: 腐蚀者玛拉斯

tasks.objective_text_en: Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra insists that you return with the Head of the Corrupter.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: Captain Rupert has asked you to collect 10 Chunks of Saronite and deliver them to Eitrigg at The Argent Stand.

tasks.objective_text_zh: 银色前沿的指挥官库恩斯要你拜访四座银色北伐军的岗哨，并完成那里的上尉交给你的任务，然后回去向他复命。 /  / 布兰顿上尉和鲁伯特上尉驻扎在东南面的达克索塔。 /  / 格隆迪尔上尉驻扎在正东边的达克迦尔。 /  / 炼金师菲肯斯坦驻扎在北边的赫布瓦罗。

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

You are then to slay Rhunok using the power that his spirit has imbued you with. /  / If for some reason you lose the Mojo of Rhunok aura, you can return to the Spirit of Rhunok to have it reapplied.

tasks.name: 黑暗的地平线
tasks.objective_text_zh: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你与高尔巴格交谈，并游览祖达克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to speak to Gorebag and take the tour of Zul'Drak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 不祥的扰动
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈克娅要求你去查明奎丝鲁恩的状况。你可以与哈克娅交谈，乘在她孩子的背上悄悄潜入奎丝鲁恩祭坛。 /  / 完成侦察任务之后，回到哈克娅祭坛向她报告。
tasks.objective_text_en: Har'koa has asked you to determine what has happened to Quetz'lun. Speak to her to be able to ride one of her children stealthily into the Altar of Quetz'lun. /  / Return to her at the Altar of Har'koa once you have done so.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 进入灵界的准备
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈克娅要求你收集8枚神圣符印，并把它们带回哈克娅祭坛交给她。
tasks.objective_text_en: Har'koa wants you to collect 8 Sacred Adornments. Deliver them to her at the Altar of Har'koa.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 寻找风蛇女神
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往奎丝鲁恩祭坛，寻找奎丝鲁恩之魂。
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 复仇的基础
tasks.objective_text_zh: 奎丝鲁恩之魂要你在她的灵魂之泉附近杀死12个巨魔，奎丝鲁恩崇拜者或蛇灵狂暴者都可以。 /  / 完成任务之后回到奎丝鲁恩祭坛向她复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Quetz'lun's Spirit has tasked you with the destruction of 12 trolls, either Quetz'lun Worshippers or Serpent-Touched Berserkers, near her Soul Fonts. /  / Only after you have accomplished this should you return to her at the Altar of Quetz'lun.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 目前为止，一切很糟
tasks.objective_text_zh: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你回到达库鲁身边并听从他的指挥。 /  / 在痛苦之匣一带对5只瘟疫之锅使用稀释药剂。 /  / 如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
tasks.objective_text_en: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to return to Drakuru and complete any tasks he has for you. /  / While at the Reliquary of Pain, you are to use the Diluting Additive on 5 Blight Cauldrons. /  / If you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 创造条件
tasks.objective_text_zh: 奎丝鲁恩之魂要你收集10块灵界能量碎片。完成任务后返回奎丝鲁恩祭坛向她复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Quetz'lun's Spirit has demanded that you collect 10 Underworld Power Fragments. Return to her at the Altar of Quetz'lun only when you have done so.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 官大一级压死人
tasks.objective_text_zh: 沃尔塔鲁斯的指挥官达库鲁要你对荒芜恶鬼使用暗示节杖，并指挥它们采集7颗荒芜水晶。
tasks.objective_text_en: Overlord Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to use the Scepter of Suggestion on the Blight Geists and then order them to harvest 7 Blight Crystals.

extra_objectives.text: Use Scepter of Suggestion to mind control Blight Geist

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 地狱的复仇
tasks.objective_text_zh: 奎丝鲁恩祭坛的奎丝鲁恩之魂要你对高阶祭司穆弗努、高阶祭司图亚图亚和高阶祭司哈文尼使用奎丝鲁恩的妖术棒，然后杀死他们。
tasks.objective_text_en: Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun wants you to use Quetz'lun's Hexxing Stick upon High Priest Mu'funu, High Priestess Tua-Tua, and High Priest Hawinni. Once you have done this, slay them.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 最后一步
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往哈克娅祭坛，请求哈克娅在灵界能量碎片中注入一丝她的精魄。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Underworld Power Fragments to Har'koa and beseech her for a portion of her spirit. You will still find her at the Altar of Har'koa.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 爆破活动
tasks.objective_text_zh: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要求你再去为达库鲁执行一项任务。 /  / 除此之外，他还要你前往痛苦之匣，使用炸药束摧毁5辆天灾车。 /  / 如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
tasks.objective_text_en: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to perform another task for Drakuru. /  / Additionally, you are to use the Explosive Charges on 5 Scourgewagons at the Reliquary of Pain. /  / If you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 危险的材料
tasks.objective_text_zh: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要你前往沃尔塔鲁斯,并完成达库鲁给予的任务。你还要从那里偷取5块采集到的荒芜水晶。 /  / 如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
tasks.objective_text_en: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to go to Voltarus and complete any tasks Drakuru has for you. While there, you are to steal 5 Harvested Blight Crystals. /  / If you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 死去神灵的血液
tasks.objective_text_zh: 哈克娅要求你收集7份犸托斯之血，并把它们带回哈克娅祭坛交给她。
tasks.objective_text_en: Har'koa has asked you to collect 7 Blood of Mam'toth. Return them to her at the Altar of Har'koa.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 种瓜得瓜种豆得豆
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死虚弱的奎丝鲁恩先知，然后通知希姆托加的巫医库弗。
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay the Drained Prophet of Quetz'lun and then inform Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 无法容忍
tasks.objective_text_zh: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你前往痛苦之匣，对一名达库鲁的仆从使用强化节杖，然后使用它的技能击败达穆克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to go to the Reliquary of Pain and use the Scepter of Empowerment on a Servant of Drakuru. You are then to use its abilities to defeat Darmuk.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 火上浇油
tasks.objective_text_zh: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你对浮肿的憎恶使用命令节杖，然后利用它们的能力在冰冷裂口击败60名达卡莱裂颅者，并将3名达卡莱酋长引诱出来。 /  / 只要击败足够数量的达卡莱裂颅者，酋长们就会出现。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to use the Scepter of Command on Bloated Abominations and then use their abilities at the Frigid Breach to kill 60 Drakkari Skullcrushers and lure out 3 Drakkari Chieftains. /  / Chieftains will appear when enough Skullcrushers have been slain.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 猛犸的复仇
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希姆托加的剥皮师埃霍奈希望你使用犸托斯勋章让被激怒的猛犸象冷静下来，然后骑乘它去消灭12个犸托斯信徒。
tasks.objective_text_en: Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga wants you to use the Medallion of Mam'toth to calm and ride an Enraged Mammoth. You are then to trample 12 Mam'toth Disciples to death.

extra_objectives.text: Use Medallion of Mam'toth to calm and ride an Enraged Mammoth

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 魔化蒂基面具战士
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希姆托加的元素驯服者德苟达要求你消灭12名魔化蒂基面具战士。
tasks.objective_text_en: Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga has asked you to destroy 12 Enchanted Tiki Warriors.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 妖术宝箱
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希姆托加的记载者图基尼要求你为他夺取12只佐尔玛兹要塞宝箱。
tasks.objective_text_en: Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga has asked you to acquire 12 Zol'Maz Stronghold Caches.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 真相大白
tasks.objective_text_zh: 沃尔塔鲁斯的达库鲁要求你通过传送器前往他的上层密室。
tasks.objective_text_en: Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to take the teleporter to his upper chamber.

extra_objectives.text: Take the teleporter to Drakuru's upper chamber

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 督军佐尔玛兹的钥匙
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希姆托加的哈克娅要求你去夺取督军佐尔玛兹的钥匙。
tasks.objective_text_en: Har'koa at Zim'Torga has asked you to acquire the Key of Warlord Zol'Maz.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 背叛
tasks.objective_text_zh: 黑锋哨站的斯特凡要求你击败达库鲁。 /  / 如果你丢失了迷惑项圈，可以返回黑锋哨站的斯特凡那里去再要一个。
tasks.objective_text_en: Stefan in Ebon Watch wants you to defeat Drakuru. /  / If you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.

extra_objectives.text: Use the Scepter of Domination to control it
Go on top of the ziggurat with Drakuru
After defeating Drakuru, go back down using this portal

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 狂暴
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希姆托加的哈克娅要你去释放阿卡里，并将这个消息通知巫医库弗。
tasks.objective_text_en: Har'koa at Zim'Torga has asked you to free Akali and then to inform Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 诸神的指引
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将完美的守卫者精华和充满活力的典狱官精华交给希姆托加的哈克娅。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Unblemished Heart of the Guardian and the Gusty Essence of the Warden to Har'koa at Zim'Torga.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 在佐尔赫布相会
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希姆托加的哈克娅要求你杀死阿卡里先知。
tasks.objective_text_en: Har'koa at Zim'Torga has asked you to slay the Prophet of Akali.

extra_objectives.text: Use the Prophet of Akali Convocation

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 银色北伐军的降落伞
tasks.objective_text_zh: 银色前沿的指挥官法斯塔夫要你为庭院里的10名银色北伐军战士或银色持盾战士配备降落伞。
tasks.objective_text_en: Commander Falstaav at The Argent Stand has asked you to equip 10 Argent Crusaders or Argent Shieldmen out in the courtyard with parachutes.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 前往圣光据点！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 圣光之望礼拜堂的北伐军战士瓦鲁斯要你前往祖达克的圣光据点，向莉安娜中士报到。
tasks.objective_text_en: Crusader Valus at Light's Trust wants you to report to Sergeant Riannah at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 银色前沿
tasks.objective_text_zh: 黑锋哨站的血玫瑰达图拉要求你去跟银色前沿的指挥官法斯塔夫谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bloodrose Datura at Ebon Watch wants you to speak with Commander Falstaav at The Argent Stand.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 吸取灵魂
tasks.objective_text_zh: 赫布瓦罗的阿纳斯上尉要求你前往扎尔金之池，从迷失的达卡莱灵魂身上收集5份上古灵质。
tasks.objective_text_en: Captain Arnath at Heb'Valok wants you to collect 5 Ancient Ectoplasms from the Lost Drakkari Spirits at the Pools of Zha'Jin.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 悬赏：怒鬃的鳍肢
tasks.objective_text_zh: 得到怒鬃的鳍肢，将它交给圣光据点的怒爪酋长。
tasks.objective_text_en: Recover Ragemane's Flipper and return it to Chief Rageclaw at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 火仍在烧！
tasks.english_name: This Just In: Fire Still Hot!
tasks.objective_text_zh: 圣光据点的萨满长者莫奇希望你前往怒爪巢穴，使用怒爪灭火器扑灭15堆火焰。
tasks.objective_text_en: Elder Shaman Moky at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak wants you to use the Rageclaw Fire Extinguisher to douse 15 hut fires at Rageclaw Den.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 巨魔疯啦！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 祖达克圣光据点的怒爪酋长希望你使用从达库鲁巨魔身上找到的达库鲁“开锁器”，解救8名被俘虏的怒爪狼獾人。
tasks.objective_text_en: Chief Rageclaw at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak wants you to use the Drakuru "Lock Openers" found on various Drakuru trolls to free 8 Captured Rageclaw.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 达库鲁的命令
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将达库鲁的命令交给祖达克圣光据点的北伐军领主兰迪加。
tasks.objective_text_en: Return the Orders From Drakuru to Crusader Lord Lantinga at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 黑锋哨站
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将达库鲁的命令交给祖达克黑锋哨站的斯特凡·瓦杜。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Orders From Drakuru to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 北伐军前线营地
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在祖达克的北伐军前线营地寻找北伐军战士马克拉尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out Crusader MacKellar at the Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 从无到有
tasks.objective_text_zh: 北伐军前线营地的工程师里德要求你收集10块天灾金属废料。
tasks.objective_text_en: Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak has asked that you recover 10 pieces of Scourge Scrap Metal.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 寻找答案
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往怒爪巢穴寻找线索，查出向怒爪狼獾人发动进攻的幕后主使。
tasks.objective_text_en: Search Rageclaw Den for a clue about who or what initiated the attacks against the Rageclaw Wolvar.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 朋友的意义……
tasks.objective_text_zh: 北伐军前线营地的北伐军战士马克拉尔要求你找到北伐军战士达加斯、戈尔克和布尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp has asked that you find Crusader Dargath, Gerk and Burr.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 圣光不能为我复仇
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塞穆之末的戈尔克希望你去消灭15个瓦古维库人。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gerk at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak wants you to kill 15 Vargul.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 风暴将至
tasks.objective_text_zh: 风暴巨人之王盖米尔要求你想办法把他从笼子里面救出来。与北伐军前线营地的工程师里德谈谈该怎么办。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gymer, King of Storm Giants, has asked you to find a way to release him from his cage. Speak with Engineer Reed at the Crusader Forward Camp.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 拯救盖米尔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 北伐军前线营地的工程师里德希望你交给他6份女妖精华和6份硅藻土。
tasks.objective_text_en: Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak wants you to bring him 6 Banshee Essence and 6 Diatomaceous Earth.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 唯一的希望
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在祖达克的塞穆之末使用巨型爆盐炸弹，打开囚禁着盖米尔的天灾围栏，然后与盖米尔谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Gymer at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak once you have used the Jumbo Seaforium Charge to open the Scourge Enclosure that is holding him prisoner.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 风暴之王的复仇
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与盖米尔交谈以开始行动。 /  / 骑着盖米尔去消灭100个天灾士兵，并消灭天选者奥贾尔、塞穆和纳瓦留斯王子。成功之后，向北伐军前线营地的北伐军战士马克拉尔报告。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Gymer to begin. /  / While riding Gymer, destroy 100 Scourge and kill Algar the Chosen, Thrym and Prince Navarius. Report to Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp should you succeed.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 痛苦斗兽场：伊戈达斯！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败伊戈达斯！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
tasks.objective_text_en: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Yggdras! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 痛苦斗兽场：猛犸人！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败恶臭之须！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
tasks.objective_text_en: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Stinkbeard! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 痛苦斗兽场：异界的对手！
tasks.english_name: The Amphitheater of Anguish: From Beyond!
tasks.objective_text_zh: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败一位元素领主！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
tasks.objective_text_en: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat one of the elemental lords! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 痛苦斗兽场：海象人的末日！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败奥里努克·碎牙！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
tasks.objective_text_en: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Orinoko Tuskbreaker! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 痛苦斗兽场：血怒者科尔拉克！
tasks.english_name: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Korrak the Bloodrager!
tasks.objective_text_zh: 进入痛苦斗兽场，击败血怒者科尔拉克！回到巨魔仆从伍迪那里领取你的奖励。
tasks.objective_text_en: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Korrak the Bloodrager! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
